annotations.title: Wallet risk check: fresh-wallet risk tier, flags, balances and nonce for a Base address

description: Screen a Base address for fresh or throwaway-wallet signals: a high/medium/low heuristic risk tier with named flags (no or one outgoing transaction, a near-empty balance with few transactions), plus ETH, USDC, WETH, cbBTC and DAI balances and the account nonce. Address type is reported separately and does not affect the tier; token contracts are not audited. Use to screen a Base address; OFAC and other chains: check_counterparty. Example: address=0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: wallet_audit
